title: Platform standup notes - 2026-03-07
content:
Attendees: Marcus Lee (owner), Aisha Gomez, Priya Natarajan, Liam O'Connor, Juno Park, +1 (notes)

Quick summary (high level):
- Control plane: continuing canary for feature-flag rollout 0.12. Minor config drift found in eu-west-1; rollback and reapply in progress.
- Routing: new policy branch for cost-aware routing merged to staging; initial perf looks good but tests show increased tail latency for small requests.
- Auth & quotas: quota migration kickoff triggered; observed 503s for a small percentage of Dedicated tenants during migration window - mitigation in flight.
- Observability: added trace sampling for control-plane admin flows; dashboards updated with per-route token counts.

Detailed updates:

Marcus - control plane
- Canary rollout for feature-flags v0.12 at 30% traffic. After 4 hours, detected config drift in eu-west-1 nodes (agent version mismatch). Rolled back canary for eu-west-1 only and triggered a targeted redeploy.
- Follow-up: open PR to add pre-rollout node version check (GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/412).
- Blocker: redeploy ETA ~2h if no further issues. Tracker: ENG-2345.

Priya - routing
- Cost-aware routing policy merged to staging (routing PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/298).
- Perf: p50 stable, p95 increased by ~60ms for payloads <128 tokens in staging tests. Hypothesis: additional per-request decision logic causing CPU jitter on small instances.
- Plan: add micro-bench harness and compare with older policy. If confirmed, push routing decision cache (TTL 5s) to reduce overhead.
- Action: Priya to run bench and share results by 2026-03-09.

Aisha - auth & quotas
- Started quota schema migration for Dedicated customers at 02:00 UTC last night. Migration job processed ~80% of backlog. Noted ~0.8% error rate causing transient 503s for a small tenant subset.
- Root cause: race between old quota-check code path and new enforcement layer during token validation. Hotfix: introduce serialized migration lock per-tenant; deployed to canary and validated.
- Action: Aisha to open postmortem draft and coordinate with CS for impacted tenants. Postmortem due 2026-03-08.

Liam - infra & observability
- Added tracing sampling for control-plane admin flows + dashboard panels for token-level cost/latency heatmaps (Dashboard ID: eng-platform-controlplane-traces).
- Noted one alert firing (control-plane config-apply-failure) - correlated with canary rollback. Suppressed noisy alerts until postmortem.
- Action: update runbook for config drift and add remediation playbook steps. Liam TODO by 2026-03-10.

Juno - release & automation
- Release pipeline tweak: gate added to ensure node version parity before canary. Preliminary test passed locally.
- Working on automated rollback policy enhancements to allow region-scoped rollbacks instead of global. Prototype merged to internal branch.
- Action: Juno to wire up tests for region-scoped rollback and validate next canary.

Incidents / Alerts
- Incident 2026-03-07-01: quota migration transient 503s for subset of Dedicated tenants. Impact: small number of customer requests failed for <10 minutes. Status: mitigated. Follow-up: postmortem (Aisha).
- Incident 2026-03-07-02: config drift detected in eu-west-1 causing canary rollback. Impact: no customer-facing errors. Status: mitigated after redeploy.

Open action items
- Marcus: add pre-rollout node-version check (PR opened) - due 2026-03-09.
- Priya: run microbench for routing policy and share results - due 2026-03-09.
- Aisha: postmortem draft for quota migration incident and CS coordination - due 2026-03-08.
- Liam: update runbook and suppress noisy alerts until mitigations are in place - due 2026-03-10.
- Juno: test region-scoped rollback in staging and report results - due 2026-03-11.

Notes / Decisions
- Agreed to add routing decision cache (TTL 5s) if benchmarks show >30ms overhead on small requests.
- Agreed to make node-version parity check a hard pre-deploy gate for canaries.

Misc
- Linked tickets: ENG-2345 (control-plane node-version), ENG-2398 (quota migration), ENG-2402 (routing perf), ENG-2410 (region rollback work).
- Next standup: 2026-03-09 09:30 PT. Suggested agenda: postmortem review, routing bench results, rollout plan for v0.12.

Notes-to-self / rough ideas
- Consider adding lightweight local cache in nginx sidecar for per-request routing decisions to avoid hitting control-plane for tiny requests.
- Explore quota-migration dry-run mode where we validate without enforcing to reduce blast radius.
